title: Author deploy.sh with health gate & automatic rollback
description: Near-zero-downtime releases with automatic rollback protect a single-server prod where a bad deploy would otherwise cause an outage (§13.5, §15). Author ops/deploy.sh (set -euo pipefail, arg=SHA): extract /tmp/sahla-$SHA.tar.gz to /opt/sahla/releases/$SHA; symlink /opt/sahla/shared/uploads into the release; source /etc/sahla/app.env; run `bin/sahla eval "Sahla.Release.migrate()"`; flip the /opt/sahla/current symlink; systemctl restart sahla; sleep then curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4000/health, and on failure relink the previous release, restart, and exit 1 (automatic rollback). Finally prune releases keeping the newest 5.
design: Rollback picks the 2nd-newest release dir. LiveView clients auto-reconnect over the 1-3s restart; funnel state is token-persisted so no user progress is lost (§13.5).
acceptance_criteria:

- shared/uploads symlink survives every release flip (no data loss)
- only the 5 newest releases remain under /opt/sahla/releases after several deploys
- script exits non-zero on any failed step (set -euo pipefail)

title: Build Oban SMS/email delivery pipeline with idempotency
description: All sends must be reliable, retried, and exactly-once, so they run as Oban jobs rather than inline (§7.3). Build `Notifications.Workers.SMSWorker` (queue :sms) and `EmailWorker` (queue :email) plus a `Notifications.deliver/…` entrypoint that writes a queued DeliveryLog with an idempotency_key, checks rate-limit/kill-switch, invokes the provider or mailer, and applies the resulting provider_id/cost/status exactly-once inside a Repo.transaction (terminal status = no-op). Retries use Oban backoff; kill-switch and rate-limit denials short-circuit without a retry storm. Jobs are unique per idempotency_key.
design: Oban sms/email queues (§7.3). Apply status exactly-once in Repo.transaction, terminal = no-op (Lessons). Oban.Migration.up() is version-agnostic. Backoff + kill-switch protect the SMS budget.
acceptance_criteria:
- sms and email Oban queues are defined with bounded retries and backoff
- A job writes a queued DeliveryLog then updates it to sent/failed with provider_id and cost
- A duplicate enqueue with the same idempotency_key does not double-send (Oban unique)
- With the kill-switch on, the job short-circuits to a no-op/failed without calling the provider
- A provider {:error} triggers an Oban retry while a terminal success stays idempotent
close_reason:
Oban SMS/email delivery pipeline with exactly-once idempotency.

Workers (lib/sahla/notifications/workers/): SMSWorker (queue :sms) + EmailWorker (queue :email), both 'use Sahla.Worker' (bounded max_attempts 3 + Oban default exponential backoff) with unique: [keys: [:idempotency_key], period: :infinity]; each just delegates to the shared core.

Context Sahla.Notifications (new lib/sahla/notifications.ex): async entrypoints deliver_sms/1 + deliver_email/1 stringify params into Oban args and Oban.insert (unique per idempotency_key). Synchronous core deliver/3 (called by workers via run_sms/2 & run_email/2): (1) ensure_queued records a :queued DeliveryLog keyed by idempotency_key, reloading the existing one on unique-conflict for retries; (2) settled? guard — a log already :sent/terminal returns :ok WITHOUT touching the provider (exactly-once); (3) channel_enabled? kill-switch pre-check → marks :failed + {:cancel, :disabled} (no provider call, no retry); (4) invokes SMS.send / Email.deliver, then finalize/3 applies the outcome inside Repo.transaction, re-checking terminal status so a status transition happens at most once. Provider {:error, :disabled|:recipient_not_allowed} → {:cancel} (no retry storm); any other {:error} → {:error} for Oban backoff retry, except on the final attempt (attempt>=max_attempts) where it marks :failed + {:cancel}. Email result normalised to the SMS {:ok, %{provider_id, cost_centimes}} shape; cost 0, provider_id from mailer meta[:id]. Email 'kind' currently supports :resume_link (the serializable builder); devis_pdf enqueuing deferred until a PDF store/regeneration exists (no quote pipeline yet).

Note: the durable exactly-once guarantee is the notifications_log.idempotency_key unique index + settled? no-op, NOT Oban uniqueness alone — so pruning Oban jobs can't cause a double-send (filed follow-up sahla-6l1 for retention/pruning policy + delivery telemetry).

Tests (test/sahla/notifications_test.exs, 9): sent-log with provider_id/cost/sent_at; duplicate delivery single-send; kill-switch no-op→failed (provider never called); non-MA recipient cancelled; transient error retries then fails on final attempt; terminal success stays idempotent after provider breaks; email sent+logged; email kill-switch; deliver_sms Oban enqueue exactly-once end-to-end.

All acceptance criteria met. Gates: mix format clean; compile --warnings-as-errors dev+prod clean; credo --strict 902 mods/funs no issues; sobelow --exit clean; full suite 430 passed (+9). NOT committed/pushed (awaiting user).

title: Create notifications_log schema with HMAC recipient hashing

Provide context functions to record/queue a message and to update status by provider_id. Reuse the security-compliance keyed-HMAC helper for to_hash. Index (to_hash), (sent_at desc, id), and (status).
design: safe_raw/1 projection + keyed-HMAC, never bare hash (Lessons). desc: :id tiebreaker for second-precision ordering (Lessons). Payload trimmed after 6 months by a retention job owned elsewhere (§12).
acceptance_criteria:
- Migration creates notifications_log with all columns plus a unique idempotency_key constraint
- to_hash uses the keyed-HMAC helper (not bare SHA256) and the raw phone/email is never persisted
- payload stores only a safe projection — test asserts no OTP code or raw phone is written
- Status updates resolve by provider_id and a terminal status is a no-op
- Indexes exist on (to_hash), (sent_at desc, id), and (status)

title: Define Notifications.SMS behaviour + Fake and Infobip adapters
description: OTP verification and every SMS depend on a swappable provider abstraction so we never couple to one gateway and can test deterministically. Define the `Notifications.SMS` behaviour with `@callback send(to, template, vars)` returning `{:ok, %{provider_id, cost_centimes}}` or `{:error, reason}`. Build `Notifications.SMSProvider.Fake` (dev/test) that records sends in ETS/Agent for assertions and never hits the network. Build `Notifications.SMSProvider.Infobip`, the real aggregator adapter, via Req/Finch with Moroccan alphanumeric sender-ID, secrets from runtime.exs (SMS_API_KEY, SMS_SENDER). Resolve the provider through Application.get_env with Fake as default; gate live sends behind a settings feature flag/kill-switch (§11 SMS row, §7.3).
design: Req/Finch only — avoid hackney idna conflict (Lessons). Secrets via runtime.exs env. Provider chosen in Phase 0; adapter documented against Infobip API, swappable. Kill-switch honored here so budget alarm can disable sends.
acceptance_criteria:
- Behaviour defines send/3; both Fake and Infobip implement it
- Fake is the default provider in dev/test and its recorded sends are inspectable in tests
- Infobip adapter builds the request with Req (no hackney dep) using sender-ID from SMS_SENDER
- Provider is resolved via Application.get_env and swappable without editing callers
- When the feature flag/kill-switch is off, send/3 returns {:error, :disabled} without calling the provider
close_reason: Notifications.SMS behaviour (@callback send/3 -> {:ok,%{provider_id,cost_centimes}}|{:error,reason}) + facade send/3 that resolves adapter via Application.get_env and honors :sms_enabled kill-switch ({:error,:disabled} without touching provider). SMSProvider.Fake (supervised Agent, records sends, sent/0+clear/0, never networks) is default. SMSProvider.Infobip via Req (no hackney): App-key auth, SMS_SENDER from-ID, base_url/req_options injectable; parses messageId->provider_id, cost_centimes from config estimate; non-2xx/transport -> error tuples. Adapter derivation follows external-provider pattern (infobip only when api_key present, else Fake). Shared SMSProvider.render/2 minimal %{var} interpolation (real FR/AR templates = tam.4). config.exs :sms_enabled default true. 9 tests: resolution (default/override/infobip+key/infobip-no-key->Fake), kill-switch disabled, Fake record+interpolation, Infobip build/2 request shape + Req.Test send parse + 401 error. Full suite 86 passing; compile -Werror + credo --strict clean.

title: Build Quoting context: create, resume and autosave API
description: LiveViews must never touch Repo; all funnel persistence flows through one context with autosave semantics (§7.2, §7.3). Build Sahla.Quoting with create_quote/1 (generates token, sets locale/ip/user_agent and a sanitized utm projection), get_quote_by_token/1 with resume semantics, upsert_step/3 that applies a validated step changeset to the quotes row (autosave), and expired handling (status expired, not resumable). The context calls the step embedded schemas for validation and returns field-keyed errors to callers.
design: Never persist raw external param maps (safe_raw/1 pattern per Lessons). Never cast admin is_* fields. Any newest-first query uses desc: :id tiebreaker on second-precision timestamps.
acceptance_criteria:
- create_quote/1 returns a draft with a unique token; concurrent creates never collide thanks to the citext unique index.
- upsert_step/3 persists only that step's fields and returns {:ok, quote} or {:error, changeset} with field-keyed errors.
- get_quote_by_token/1 returns nil/error for unknown or expired tokens; an expired quote is not resumable.
- utm is stored as a sanitized projection; a test asserts unexpected/raw param keys are dropped.
- Context has no LiveView dependency; tests cover the create/resume/autosave round-trip.
close_reason: Built Sahla.Quoting context: create_quote/1 (token gen, utm sanitization to known projection, locale/ip/user_agent), get_quote_by_token/1 (nil for unknown+expired, expired not resumable), upsert_step/3 (per-step embedded validation, persists only changed fields, advances current_step, field-keyed errors), validate_step/3, expire_quote/1. Vehicle conditional value reads quote.formula; contact encrypts phone + drops consent booleans. 10 context tests, full suite 228 green, credo clean.

title: Build per-step embedded schemas and inline field errors
description: Each funnel step needs independent validation with inline per-field errors before autosave, avoiding one giant quote changeset (§5.2, §7.3). Build four Ecto embedded schemas (Sahla.Quoting.Steps.Vehicle/Driver/Coverage/Contact) with cast + validate rules: date sanity (birth_date and license_date in the past, license after legal driving age), fiscal_power > 0, conditional vehicle_value required when formula is tiers_etendu/tous_risques, +212 phone format, required consents, crm in 0.50-2.50. Provide a field-error helper/function component that renders one message per field, keyed by field, for the step components to consume.
design: HEEx cannot read module attributes, so errors are passed as socket assigns to the component. Conditional vehicle_value is driven by the formula chosen in step 3. Keep schemas pure and free of Repo.
acceptance_criteria:
- Each step schema validates independently; invalid input yields errors keyed to the exact offending field.
- vehicle_value is required only when formula is tiers_etendu or tous_risques; tests cover both branches.
- birth_date/license_date rejected when in the future or when license precedes legal age; boundary tests included.
- +212 phone format validated and crm outside 0.50-2.50 rejected.
- Error helper renders exactly one message per invalid field; unit tests assert message presence.
close_reason: Built 4 pure embedded step schemas (Steps.{Vehicle,Driver,Coverage,Contact}) + Steps helper (field_errors one-msg-per-field, date/phone/consent validators). Corrected usage(4)/franchise_pref(basse/standard/elevee) enums via shared Quoting.Enums; updated quotes CHECKs. 29 step tests + full suite (218) green, credo clean, prod compiles.

title: Create quotes migration and Quoting.Quote schema
description: The quotes row is the funnel's single source of truth: every answer autosaves here and it must protect PII per Lessons. Build the migration and Sahla.Quoting.Quote schema with all section 8 columns (§8): token citext unique, status Ecto.Enum(draft|completed|expired) with CHECK, current_step, locale; vehicle fields (plate, is_new_ww, make_id/model_id/version_id, fiscal_power, fuel, first_registration, vehicle_value_centimes, usage, city_id, parking); driver fields (birth_date, license_date, is_public_servant, current_insurer_id, current_expiry, at_fault_claims_36m, crm numeric(3,2), releve_doc_path); coverage (formula, options text[], franchise_pref, effect_date); contact (first_name, last_name, phone_enc cloak, phone_hash, email citext, phone_verified_at); utm jsonb, ip inet, user_agent, rating_run_id. Add indexes quotes(token) and quotes(phone_hash).
design: Cloak.Ecto.Binary for phone_enc; keyed-HMAC phone_hash per Lessons, never bare SHA256. Admin/rating fields (is_*, rating_run_id) never cast from user changesets. Store only a safe utm projection. rating_run_id fk deferred until rating_runs exists.
acceptance_criteria:
- Migration creates quotes with a citext unique token index and a phone_hash index; ecto.migrate and rollback run clean.
- Ecto.Enum values for status/usage/parking/formula/franchise_pref are enforced and backed by DB CHECK constraints.
- phone_enc uses Cloak.Ecto.Binary and phone_hash is a keyed HMAC (not bare SHA256); a round-trip test encrypts/decrypts and proves the hash is deterministic.
- Money columns are integer centimes and all ids are uuid; a draft with only token+locale inserts successfully (contact fields nullable).
- crm stored as numeric(3,2) and options as text[]; test asserts a value inside 0.50-2.50 persists.
close_reason: Quoting.Quote schema + quotes migration + Sahla.Types.IP (inet<->string Ecto type, reusable for consents/audit). All §8 columns: token citext unique, status/usage/parking/formula/franchise_pref/fuel Ecto.Enum + DB CHECK (nullable-tolerant), current_step, locale; vehicle/driver/coverage/contact/context groups; FKs to makes/models/versions/cities/insurers (on_delete nilify_all), rating_run_id plain binary_id (FK deferred to 8vo.6). PII: phone via virtual :phone -> phone_enc (Cloak.Ecto.Binary) + phone_hash (keyed HMAC, not bare SHA256), both put_change'd from plaintext. crm numeric(3,2) validated 0.50-2.50; options text[]; vehicle_value_centimes integer >=0; utm jsonb; ip inet via Types.IP. create_changeset generates URL-safe token; changeset never casts status/phone_verified_at/phone_hash/phone_enc/rating_run_id. 12 tests: draft(token+locale) insert, token uniqueness, enum reject/persist, phone encrypt round-trip + deterministic HMAC + ciphertext!=plaintext bytes, crm range persist/reject, options array, centimes int/negatives, ip valid/invalid. Migrate+rollback clean. Full suite 138 passing; compile -Werror + credo --strict clean.

title: Persist immutable rating_runs and offers snapshot at completion
description: Every displayed price must be reproducible for ACAPS/compliance (§7.3, §9.1): persist inputs + table versions + results immutably at funnel completion. Add schemas Rating.Run (rating_runs: quote_id, engine_version, table_versions jsonb, inputs jsonb, duration_us) and Quoting.Offer (offers: rating_run_id, quote_id, insurer_id, product_id, formula, annual_premium_centimes, monthly_equiv_centimes, breakdown jsonb, badges[], rank, selected_at). Provide a boundary function Rating.snapshot(quote, offers, meta) writing the run plus all offers inside one Repo.transaction and setting quotes.rating_run_id. Store a non-PII projection of inputs (safe_raw) — never raw contact PII — and expose no update/delete path (append-only). monthly_equiv = round(annual / 12).
design: Store safe_raw projection, never the raw external payload (Lessons/PII). uuid ids. Measure duration_us around Engine.run. §7.3 immutable snapshot, §8.
acceptance_criteria:
- snapshot/3 inserts one rating_run plus N offers atomically in a transaction; a partial failure rolls everything back
- rating_runs stores engine_version and table_versions (code=>version map) sufficient to reproduce the run
- inputs jsonb stores only a non-PII projection — test asserts phone/name/email are absent
- Offers persist breakdown, badges and rank; monthly_equiv_centimes == round(annual/12)
- quotes.rating_run_id is set to the created run
- No update or delete API is exposed on runs/offers (append-only)
close_reason: Rating.Run (rating_runs) + Quoting.Offer (offers) schemas + migration + Sahla.Rating.snapshot/3 boundary. rating_runs: quote_id fk, engine_version, table_versions jsonb (code=>version), inputs jsonb (non-PII), duration_us; append-only (no update/delete API). offers: rating_run_id/quote_id/insurer_id/product_id fks, formula Ecto.Enum+CHECK, annual/monthly_equiv centimes, breakdown jsonb, badges text[], rank, selected_at. snapshot/3 writes run + N offers + sets quotes.rating_run_id in ONE Repo.transaction (insert not insert! + Repo.rollback -> {:error,changeset} on partial failure, full rollback). safe_inputs/1 drops PII (phone/name/email/plate/ip/ua) + catalog and stringifies Decimal/Date for jsonb. monthly_equiv defaults round(annual/12). ALSO wired the deferred FKs: quotes.rating_run_id->rating_runs, leads.offer_id->offers (alter table). 4 tests: atomic run+2offers+quote link, inputs PII-free projection (phone/name/email absent, crm/today stringified), offers persist breakdown/badges/rank + monthly==round(annual/12), partial-failure full rollback. Full suite 182 passing; compile -Werror + credo --strict clean.

title: Implement pure Rating.Engine.run computing offers per formula 9.1
description: The heart of the product: compute indicative premiums for every insurer×formula from tables, pure and reproducible (§9.1, §7.2). Build Rating.Engine.run(inputs, tables) :: [Offer.t()] with no DB or side effects. For each active insurer × eligible product(formula): base_rc via band(fiscal_power, fuel, vehicle_kind) lookup in rc_base; premium_rc = base_rc × usage_factor × city_factor × crm; options_sum from option_pricing (vehicle_value, franchise_pref); evcat always-on from the taxes_fees EVCAT rule (Law 110-14); subtotal × insurer_positioning[insurer][formula]; total = subtotal × (1 + tax_rate) + fixed_fees; round_to_dirham. Each offer carries a full breakdown map (rc, options[], evcat, taxes, fees). CRM comes from Rating.CRM; the insurer/product catalog is passed in inputs to keep the engine pure.
design: Money in integer centimes; round to dirham = nearest 100 centimes. Pure module → property- and golden-tested. Tables and catalog injected, not queried. §9.1.
acceptance_criteria:
- run/2 returns one offer per active insurer×eligible product, with annual_premium_centimes rounded to a whole dirham (multiple of 100 centimes)
- Breakdown lines sum exactly to the total for every offer (assert total == Σ breakdown)
- An EVCAT line is always present and positive regardless of chosen options (Law 110-14)
- The unknown-CRM path marks the offer estimated ("à confirmer")
- The function performs no DB calls — the test runs without Repo/sandbox
- A missing band or ineligible product is skipped without crashing and never yields a negative line
close_reason: Pure Rating.Engine.run(inputs, tables) :: [Offer.t()] + Rating.Offer struct. No DB/side effects (tables + insurer/product catalog injected). Per §9.1: base_rc from rc_base band(fiscal_power,fuel); premium_rc = base_rc × usage_factor × city_factor × crm (via Rating.CRM); options_sum from option_pricing (flat annual_centimes OR rate×vehicle_value, optional franchise multiplier); evcat always-on = max(premium_rc×rate, min_centimes) (Law 110-14); subtotal=(rc+options+evcat)×insurer_positioning[slug][formula]; total=subtotal×(1+tax_rate)+fixed_fees, round_to_dirham (nearest 100 centimes). Integer centimes throughout; dirham-rounding residue booked to a breakdown :rounding line so lines sum exactly to total. Missing band -> [] (no crash); unknown option/positioning -> 0/1.0 defaults. estimated? set when CRM derived. 9 pure tests (async, no Repo): one offer/entry + dirham-rounded, breakdown sums to total, EVCAT always positive w/o options, no negative substantive lines, known-vs-estimated flag, positioning differentiation, missing-band->[], unknown-option->0, claims monotonicity. Full suite 170 passing; compile -Werror + credo --strict clean.

title: Resolve latest published tables via ETS cache with publish invalidation
description: The engine must deterministically pick "latest published table effective ≤ today" in-process and fast (<100ms, §9.2), so resolution is ETS-cached and invalidated on publish. Build Rating.Tables context: publish(table, effective_from) transitions draft→published and archives the prior published row of the same code; resolve(code, on_date \\ today) returns the greatest effective_from ≤ date among published rows; load_all/1 returns %{code => data} for all seven codes for engine consumption. Back it with a Rating.TableCache GenServer owning an ETS table, warmed on boot and refreshed on publish via a rating:tables PubSub broadcast, falling back to Repo on cache miss.
design: Order by desc: effective_from, tiebreak desc: version then desc: id. GenServer owns the ETS table; PubSub topic rating:tables. §9.2.
acceptance_criteria:
- resolve/2 returns the published row with greatest effective_from ≤ date, ignoring draft/archived (test with three versions)
- Publishing a new version archives the prior published row of the same code and refreshes the cache
- Cache hits avoid Repo (asserted via query count or telemetry); a cold cache loads from Repo then serves from ETS
- load_all/1 returns a map covering all seven codes for engine consumption
- A resolve concurrent with a publish returns a consistent snapshot, never a partial table set
close_reason: Rating.Tables context + Rating.TableCache GenServer (ETS). resolve/2 returns published row with greatest effective_from <= date (ignores draft/archived); load_all/1 returns %{code=>data} for all 7 codes; publish/2 transitions draft->published + archives prior published of same code in a transaction, then refreshes cache + broadcasts rating:tables PubSub. TableCache owns ETS with a SINGLE key holding %{code=>[rows]} snapshot (atomic single-lookup reads -> resolve/load_all never see a partial table set); warmed on boot (tolerant of missing DB conn), refreshed on publish + PubSub :refresh; published_by_code is the only read touching Repo. 5 tests (async:false, shared sandbox): resolve 3-version date selection + nil-before-effective, publish archives prior + cache auto-refresh, cache cold-loads-from-Repo/warm-hits-ETS-only (telemetry query count), load_all all 7 codes, 50 concurrent load_all during publish always return 7-key map. Full suite 153 passing; compile -Werror + credo --strict clean.

title: Build versioned rate_tables schema with per-code jsonb validation
description: All rating numbers must live in versioned data with zero business numbers in code (§9.1), so ops recalibrate without deploys. Create Ecto schema Rating.Table backing rate_tables: code enum (rc_base|usage_factor|city_factor|crm|option_pricing|insurer_positioning|taxes_fees), version int, status enum (draft|published|archived), effective_from date, data jsonb, checksum, published_by fk, notes. Add per-code validators (Rating.Table.Schema) enforcing each jsonb shape — rc_base band arrays, crm ladder, option_pricing, insurer_positioning coefficients, taxes_fees incl. the always-on EVCAT rule (Law 110-14). Changeset recomputes a deterministic checksum, blocks edits to published/archived rows, and never casts status/published_by from any public-facing changeset. Migration adds CHECK constraints and a unique (code, version) index.
design: Checksum = SHA256 of canonicalized JSON. No PII in tables. Admin-only status must never be cast/3 from user changesets (Lessons). effective_from drives resolution. §8 Rating, §9.2.
acceptance_criteria:
- Migration creates rate_tables with code/status CHECK constraints and a unique index on (code, version)
- Rating.Table.changeset/2 validates each code's jsonb against its schema; an rc_base band missing annual_centimes is rejected with a field error
- Checksum is recomputed deterministically from data; test asserts identical data yields identical checksum
- Changeset returns an error when data changes on a row whose status is not draft (published/archived immutable)
- status and published_by are not castable from a non-privileged changeset (test asserts they are dropped)
close_reason: Rating.Table schema + rate_tables migration + Rating.Table.Schema per-code jsonb validator. 7 codes (rc_base|usage_factor|city_factor|crm|option_pricing|insurer_positioning|taxes_fees) as Ecto.Enum + DB CHECK; status draft|published|archived CHECK; unique (code,version) index; data jsonb; effective_from date; published_by_id binary_id (real FK to admins deferred to r5o.3). Per-code validators enforce shapes (rc_base bands w/ cv_min/cv_max/fuel/annual_centimes; taxes_fees w/ tax_rate 0..1, fixed_fees_centimes, always-on EVCAT rate+min_centimes per Law 110-14; insurer_positioning formula whitelist; city_factor requires zones 1/2/3; etc). Deterministic checksum = SHA256 of recursively key-sorted canonical JSON (order-independent). changeset/2: validates data, recomputes checksum, guards published/archived immutability, never casts status/published_by_id; publish_changeset/2 casts them. 15 tests: rc_base missing annual_centimes field error, EVCAT required, unknown formula, missing zones, checksum determinism+change+stored, immutability, admin-only casting, unique, Postgres round-trip. Full suite 109 passing; compile -Werror + credo --strict clean.

title: Add pg_trgm ranked vehicle autocomplete API
description: The funnel replaces plate/VIN registry prefill with a fast marque->modele->version autocomplete (§3.3, §5.2). Implement Sahla.Vehicles.Catalog search functions using pg_trgm similarity: search_makes/1, search_models/2 (scoped by make), search_versions/2 (scoped by model), each ranked by trigram similarity to the query with popular-first tiebreaking, and returning fiscal_power/fuel/seats for versions to drive prefill. Cap result counts, normalize accents/case, and keep the API pure query functions callable by the funnel LiveView. No LiveView UI here — just the context API.
design: popular-first ordering needs an explicit tiebreaker; similarity ties on second data resolve by popular then name (analogous to the desc: :id Lesson). Pure query functions only — LiveView calls the context, never Repo.
acceptance_criteria:
- search_makes/models/versions return trigram-ranked results using the GIN indexes (EXPLAIN shows index usage on realistic data)
- Results are ordered by similarity desc, then popular desc, then name asc for stable ties
- Version results include fiscal_power, fuel, seats for prefill
- Queries are scoped (models by make_id, versions by model_id) and result-capped (e.g. 10)
- Case/accent-insensitive matching verified by tests (e.g. 'megane' matches 'Mégane')
- Property/edge tests cover empty query and no-match returning []
close_reason: Sahla.Vehicles.Catalog: search_makes/2, search_models/3 (scoped by make_id), search_versions/3 (scoped by model_id). Accent+case-insensitive via new migration adding unaccent extension + IMMUTABLE sahla_unaccent wrapper + functional trigram GIN indexes on sahla_unaccent(name) for makes/models/versions; index-backed ILIKE '%q%' filter ranked by similarity() desc, then popular desc (makes) / name asc, then id desc. Version results are full structs (fiscal_power/fuel/seats for prefill). Result-capped at 10 (opts :limit override). Pure query fns; LiveView never touches Repo. EXPLAIN ANALYZE on 20k rows shows Bitmap Index Scan on vehicle_models_name_unaccent_trgm_idx (genuine planner choice); deterministic seqscan-off test also asserts index usage. 9 new tests (accent/case-insensitive megane->Megane & citroen->Citroen, similarity+popular+name ordering, scoping, cap, empty/nil/no-match -> []). Full suite 53 passing; compile -Werror + credo --strict clean. NOTE: ni1.3's plain name gin_trgm_ops indexes are now superseded by the unaccent functional indexes for search — a future cleanup task could drop them if disk/write cost matters.

title: Build Vehicles catalog schemas: makes, models, versions
description: Morocco has no plate/VIN registry, so a marque/modele/version catalog powers vehicle identification and puissance-fiscale prefill (§3.3, §5.2 step 1). Create migrations + schemas for vehicle_makes (name, popular bool), vehicle_models (make_id, name), vehicle_versions (model_id, name, fiscal_power int, fuel, seats, new_value_centimes, years int4range). Add trigram GIN indexes on vehicle_models.name and vehicle_versions.name (§8 Indexes). Provide the Sahla.Vehicles context with resolve helpers (make->model->version lookups, fiscal_power fetch). fuel constrained via Ecto.Enum + CHECK. years stored as Postgres int4range for model-year eligibility.
design: fiscal_power is the dominant RC rating factor (§3.1) — must be reliably prefilled and editable. int4range lets a version span production years. Trigram indexes are prerequisites for the autocomplete task.
acceptance_criteria:
- Three migrations create makes/models/versions with uuid pks and FK chain make->model->version
- Trigram GIN indexes exist on vehicle_models.name and vehicle_versions.name
- vehicle_versions.new_value_centimes is integer centimes; years is int4range; fiscal_power is int4
- fuel enum (essence|diesel|hybride|electrique) enforced by Ecto.Enum + CHECK constraint
- Vehicles context returns fiscal_power for a version and supports popular-first make listing
- Tests cover int4range containment query and FK cascade behaviour
close_reason: Vehicles catalog: Make/Model/Version schemas + 3 migrations with uuid pks and make->model->version FK chain (on_delete: delete_all cascade). Trigram GIN indexes on vehicle_models.name & vehicle_versions.name via Sahla.Migration.trigram_index/3 (confirmed USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops) in pg_indexes). new_value_centimes integer centimes; fiscal_power int; fuel Ecto.Enum + DB CHECK (essence|diesel|hybride|electrique); years int4range via custom Sahla.Vehicles.YearRange Ecto.Type mapping inclusive Elixir ranges (2015..2020) <-> Postgrex.Range. Vehicles context: list_makes (popular-first), list_models_for_make, list_versions_for_model, versions_for_model_in_year (int4range containment), fiscal_power_for_version. 8 new tests (fuel enum, YearRange round-trip, containment query, FK cascade, popular-first, fiscal_power fetch); full suite 44 passing; compile -Werror + credo --strict clean.

title: Build Directory schemas: insurers, products, guarantees

Create migrations + Ecto schemas for insurers (slug, name_fr/ar, logo_path, acaps_ref, phone, rating numeric(2,1), active, position), products (insurer_id, kind enum auto|moto|voyage|habitation, formula enum rc|tiers_etendu|tous_risques, name_fr/ar, cg_document_path, installments_available, active), guarantees (fixed code list: rc, vol, incendie, bris_glace, pta, defense_recours, assistance, individuelle, evenements_climatiques, evcat), and product_guarantees (product_id, guarantee_code, included, ceiling_centimes, franchise_centimes, notes_fr/ar). design: cg_document_path is just a path column here; upload/serving is admin-studio. active/installments_available are admin-only booleans — never cast/3 from public changesets (Lesson). Paired _fr/_ar columns, not jsonb (§8).

- Four migrations create tables with uuid pks, FKs, and CHECK constraints on kind/formula/guarantee code enums
- guarantees seeded/constrained to exactly the 10 codes from §8; unique index on code
- product_guarantees ceiling_centimes and franchise_centimes are integers (centimes), nullable per matrix

Admin-only active & installments_available guarded (safe changeset/2 vs admin_changeset/2). Context: list_insurers/list_active_insurers/list_products/list_products_for_insurer with desc: :id tiebreaker. 15 new tests (enum+DB CHECK rejection, FK integrity, centimes round-trip, admin guard, ordering); full suite 36 passing; compile -Werror + credo --strict clean.

title: Build locale plug, /ar route mirror & html lang/dir
description: Arabic must be a first-class mirror of every route with correct direction, so locale resolution and routing land early (§5.1, §6.3). Build SahlaWeb.Plugs.Locale resolving locale in order path (/ar) -> cookie -> session -> accept-language header -> default fr, then setting Gettext locale, Cldr locale, and a :locale/:dir assign. Add the /ar scope in the router mirroring all public routes, and an on_mount hook so LiveViews inherit locale. The root layout consumes the assigns to emit <html lang dir>. Persist the resolved locale to session/cookie for continuity.
design: Resolution order is exact (Lessons). ar => dir=rtl. Provide the on_mount so every LiveView, including the funnel, gets locale without per-view code. Cookie persistence is what the language switcher writes.
acceptance_criteria:
- SahlaWeb.Plugs.Locale resolves in exact order path -> cookie -> session -> accept-language -> default fr
- Router exposes an /ar scope mirroring every public route to the same LiveViews/controllers
- Plug sets Gettext + Cldr locale and assigns :locale and :dir (ltr/rtl)
- A live_session on_mount propagates locale to LiveViews; root layout emits correct lang/dir
- Plug tests cover each resolution branch incl. Arabic accept-language falling to ar and unknown falling to fr
close_reason: Built i18n routing/locale plumbing: Sahla.Cldr backend (fr/ar) + ex_cldr default_backend config; SahlaWeb.Plugs.Locale resolving path(/ar)->cookie->session->accept-language(q-weighted)->default fr, setting Gettext+Cldr locale, assigning :locale/:dir, persisting to session+cookie; SahlaWeb.LocaleHook on_mount for live_session; router adds plug to browser+admin pipelines, /ar scope mirroring public routes inside live_session :public; root layout emits <html lang dir>. 16 plug/hook tests (every resolution branch incl q-weights, ar-MA, unknown->fr, exact path) + 2 /ar render tests, full suite 282 green, credo clean, prod compiles.

title: Set up Gettext with fr default + ar and English dev-keys
description: All UI copy is translated, so Gettext must be wired before any translatable string is written (§6.3). Configure the Sahla.Gettext backend and SahlaWeb helper, set locales [fr, ar] with fr as default, and adopt English dev-key msgids (e.g. gettext("Compare")) so catalogs stay reviewable. Create priv/gettext/{fr,ar}/LC_MESSAGES structure with a default domain plus a separate 'errors' domain, and ensure mix gettext.extract/merge round-trips cleanly. Add the mix aliases needed so extraction runs on demand. Do not leave empty catalogs as the final state — authoring is separate tasks.
design: English dev-keys keep msgids stable and catalogs readable; FR/AR are authored in i18n-rtl.fr-catalog / ar-catalog — never ship empty catalogs. Errors domain separated so Ecto changeset messages translate cleanly.
acceptance_criteria:

title: Enforce mandatory TOTP 2FA with QR provisioning
description: TOTP 2FA is mandatory for all admins (§10, §12) so the login flow must gate on a verified second factor. Extend `Accounts` with TOTP mechanics using nimble_totp: generate a secret, store it cloak-encrypted in Admin.totp_secret_enc, render a provisioning QR via eqrcode (otpauth:// URI with the settings/gettext display name as issuer — no hardcoded brand), and verify enrollment before activation. Add `Accounts.valid_totp?/2` (nimble_totp verification with a ±1 step drift window and last-used-timestamp replay guard). Build the two-stage login: password success sets a half-authenticated session that only becomes full after TOTP verification; unenrolled admins are forced through setup on first login. Wire a require_2fa check consumed by the router.
design: nimble_totp + eqrcode per §7.4. Replay guard: persist last-accepted timestep. Issuer/account label sourced from Settings so brand stays TBD (Phase 0). Half-auth session pattern keeps 2FA truly mandatory.
acceptance_criteria:
- New admins are forced into TOTP enrollment before reaching any /admin page
- eqrcode renders a scannable otpauth:// QR; issuer label comes from settings, not a literal brand string
- valid_totp? accepts a current code, rejects an expired/incorrect one, and rejects replay of the last-used code
- Password-only session cannot access protected admin routes until TOTP is verified
- totp_secret is stored encrypted (cloak) and never rendered after initial provisioning
- Tests cover enrollment, correct code, wrong code, drift boundary, and replay rejection
close_reason:
Mandatory TOTP 2FA with QR provisioning + two-stage admin login.

Accounts (lib/sahla/accounts.ex): setup_totp/1 (NimbleTOTP.secret, stored cloak-encrypted in totp_secret_enc, resets enrollment), totp_provisioning_uri/2 (otpauth:// with issuer/label from Settings.display_name — no hardcoded brand), totp_qr_svg/1 (eqrcode inline SVG, XML prolog stripped), activate_totp/2 (enrollment confirm), totp_enrolled?/1, valid_totp?/2 (pure predicate), verify_totp/2 (persists guard). Private accepted_at/2 searches a ±1-step drift window and records the MATCHED period (not wall-clock now) as totp_last_used_at, fed to NimbleTOTP :since so a code accepted via drift blocks only itself, never a newer one; replaying any accepted code is rejected. Migration 20260704120024 adds totp_confirmed_at (enrollment gate) + totp_last_used_at (replay guard).

Two-stage login: AdminAuth.start_admin_2fa/2 sets a half-auth session (:admin_pending_id/:admin_pending_version) with NO :admin_token, so protected routes stay unreachable until TOTP passes; get_pending_admin/1 reloads via get_admin_for_session (active+version checked). SessionController (new/create/delete): password success -> half-auth -> redirect to /admin/totp (enrolled) or /admin/totp/setup (unenrolled, forced). TotpController (setup/confirm/verify/submit) with require_pending_admin plug; only a correct code calls log_in_admin to mint the full session. Router: /admin/login,/logout,/totp* reachable without full auth; /admin behind require_admin pipeline. DashboardController is a minimal authenticated landing (real admin surfaces are future work).

Tests: test/sahla/accounts/totp_test.exs (enrollment, correct/wrong code, drift boundary now-30 accepted / now-90 rejected, replay, settings-sourced issuer, prolog-free SVG) + test/sahla_web/controllers/admin/auth_flow_test.exs (forced enrollment end-to-end, password-only cannot reach /admin, cold-entry guard, enrolled login, wrong-code re-render). All 6 acceptance criteria met.

Gates: mix format clean; compile --warnings-as-errors dev+prod clean; credo --strict 865 mods/funs no issues; sobelow --exit clean; full suite 421 passed (+15). Migrations applied dev+test. Note: user-facing gettext msgids added but not extracted to .po (deferred to the i18n tasks). NOT committed/pushed (awaiting user).

When unknown, derive it: start at 1.00, apply the per claim-free-year reduction (×0.90, floor 0.50) from license_date, then the per at-fault-claim majoration (×1.20, cap 2.50) using at_fault_claims_36m. title: Build append-only Audit context & mutation helper
description: Every admin mutation and consent must leave an immutable trail for CNDP/ACAPS defensibility (§10.10, §12). Create the `Audit` context with `Audit.Entry` schema: admin_id, action, entity, entity_id, before jsonb, after jsonb, ip, and an `at` timestamp — append-only, no update/delete functions exposed. Provide `Audit.log/1` (and a transaction-aware `Audit.log_multi/2` for Ecto.Multi) that all admin write paths call. Enforce immutability with a DB trigger (or REVOKE UPDATE/DELETE for the app role) so history cannot be rewritten. Store only non-PII projections in before/after (safe_raw pattern) — never dump raw encrypted fields or external payloads. Retention is 5 years (§12), later enforced by an Oban maintenance job.
design: Newest-first on second-precision timestamps needs desc: :id tiebreaker (Lessons). safe_raw/1 projection avoids persisting PII/raw payloads. Immutability via DB trigger is stronger than app-only discipline.
acceptance_criteria:
- audit_entries table has no ORM update/delete path; a DB-level guard rejects UPDATE/DELETE
- Audit.log persists admin_id, action, entity, entity_id, before/after jsonb, ip, at
- Audit.log_multi composes into an Ecto.Multi so the entry commits atomically with the mutation
- before/after store non-PII projections; raw encrypted/external payloads are never written
- ordering helper returns newest-first using desc: at with a desc: id tiebreaker
- Tests assert a logged entry is created and that UPDATE/DELETE against the table is rejected
close_reason: Built append-only Audit context. Migration: audit_entries (admin_id fk nilify, action, entity, entity_id, before/after jsonb, ip inet, at) + recency index (at DESC, id DESC) + a plpgsql BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger that RAISEs 'append-only' (immutability stronger than app discipline). Audit.Entry schema (no update/delete changeset; before/after scrubbed via SafeRaw). Audit.log/1, log_multi/2 (unique step name -> Ecto.Multi, commits atomically with the mutation), recent/1 + for_entity/2 (newest-first desc:at,desc:id). 8 tests: persists all fields, required action/entity, SafeRaw strips PII, multi atomic commit + rollback, ordering tiebreaker, and DB-level UPDATE + DELETE rejection. Full suite 327 green, credo clean, prod compiles.
